Class PaintService

java.lang.Object
dev.despical.pixelpainter.service.PaintService
public final class PaintService extends Object
Coordinates one bounded world operation and its persistent undo history.

Public operations are synchronized and a ticker on the global region drives the job. Creation validates bounds, budgets, history capacity and journal overlap. Chunk tickets are acquired incrementally and loaded asynchronously before a scan captures ordinary block data. A worker saves the complete journal before painting writes are allowed.

Block access is grouped by chunk. Each batch runs on the region scheduler of its chunk, one batch at a time, so the service works on Paper's single server thread and on Folia's regionized threads alike. Batch results are merged under the service lock.

Restoration changes only blocks that still match the intended output. Later edits and block entities are preserved; conflicts retain the journal. Cancel, disconnect and shutdown release world resources while retaining any durable record needed to restore partial work.
